name: revised-down
about: §4R L2: Meta revised yesterday's numbers down overnight; the fold holds only the revised figures, which are smaller than the first report.

output.headline: On November 2, 2026, Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign running and brought in 2 leads on $110.90 in spend.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet delivered 6,015 impressions, 70 clicks, and a click rate of 1.2%, with a cost per lead of $55.45.
November 2026 has 29 days left, and $198.00 has been spent on Meta so far this month.
The 2026-09-21 cohort produced 38 leads: 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 converted (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost after conversion (21.1%).
The 2026-09-28 cohort produced 40 leads: 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 converted (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost after conversion (22.5%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion — but it is too young to judge its rates.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system.
